title: Preparation of a new BTEAB/DMSO deep eutectic solvent for highly efficient starch dissolution and succinylation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,8322-8336
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08988C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mohamed El Farkhani, Omar Azougagh, Mohamed Azzouzi, Said Dadou, Meryem Abida, Mohamed El Miz, Soufian El Barkany, Noureddine Benchat, Mohammed Koudad
A new BTEAB/DMSO deep eutectic solvent is synthesized and reported for the first time. The system enables catalyst-free succinylation of starch in a single reactive solvent medium.
